name: Zhifangzi
source:
In the Chinese New Year of 2018, Zhao Ying's family is about to move out of their small 60 square meter house, and she will finally be able to obtain her first room of her own in life. But this seems to be the last good news of the year...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3528450/_/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
2018年过年，赵莹一家人即将搬出60平米的小房子，她也终于能拥有人生中的第一间房间了。但这似乎是今年最后一个好消息了……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3528450/_/]Steam[/url]]
